title: Review Before Release Checklist
source: Non-Tech Change Management with AI Assistance Playbook, Section 5 (Review Before Release)

independence.low: Owner can perform the review and testing.
independence.medium: Independent review by another person required — the reviewer must not be the builder.
independence.high: Reviewer must not be the builder; formal Architecture/Tech R&D, SRE, and Information Security reviews are also required, concluded by a formal approval task approved by one of risk-criteria.json tiers[high].formalApproval.approvers.
independence.tierSource: Use the BPT-confirmed risk level when PROJECT.md ## Risk Level records one (risk-criteria.json bptConfirmation); otherwise the assessed level.
independence.leadTime: Start the review at least 14 days before the planned production deployment (golive-gate.json review-lead-time).
independence.enforcementNote: The tier strings above quote the playbook. Operationally, 'not the builder' is enforced as a role exclusion: the reviewer is neither the Project Owner nor the Support Contact recorded for the project — see review-proof.json 'independence' for the resolution order and identity matching. Appearing among the repo's git commit authors does NOT disqualify a reviewer. review-before-release asks for the reviewer's name; seal-review-proof performs the machine check.

items.check: The tool meets the owner's requirements — it does what the owner asked
Main functionality has been tested with realistic input
items.evidenceSource: docs/TEST-SCENARIO.md — the test-case dossier generated by golive-gate:generate-test-scenarios. Use it as the evidence for this item: agent-checkable scenarios are run by the builder; the reviewer verifies and marks the verify:human scenarios here. Pass this item only when no important/sensitive scenario is FAILED or STALE. Severity maps from category (test-policy.json): High/Medium severity = sensitive/important.

items.check: The correct, intended data sources are being used
No sensitive data in AI prompts, sample data, logs, or source code
Passwords, tokens, and secret keys are not stored in code or config
Access is restricted to intended users only (least privilege)
Code is saved in approved company storage (github.com/acme-org-ops)
items.hint: git remote -v should point to github.com/acme-org-ops

items.check: A previous working version is saved and can be restored (rollback possible)
items.hint: look for a git tag, release, or saved branch of the last working version

items.check: Support ownership is defined (Project Owner and Support Contact in PROJECT.md), each in its required identity format
items.formatSource: golive-gate.json item ownership-support-contacts, fields — Project Owner is a GitHub username (existing, acme-org-ops member); Support Contact is an email (no public webmail, no shared lab/group account). This checklist reports a violation; the owner fixes it at /vibe-check, which owns the ask-and-rewrite.

items.check: All required formal approvals are completed before go-live, including the formal approval task (one of the formalApproval approvers)
